data.notes: May 2026 in Tokyo is unusually stacked, with Golden Week concerts, Tokyo Dome-scale J-pop/K-pop, a major rock festival, and heavyweight house/techno club bookings.

events.title: TM NETWORK TOUR 2026 QUANTUM
events.summary: TM NETWORK bring their QUANTUM tour to Ariake Arena for two Tokyo dates, May 1 and 2, with evening start times listed by the venue.

events.title: La Folle Journée TOKYO 2026
events.summary: Tokyo's edition of La Folle Journée runs over Golden Week at Tokyo International Forum under the 2026 theme “LES FLEUVES.” The official overview confirms the May 3–5 festival dates.

events.title: Poppin'Party × Roselia Joint Live
events.summary: BanG Dream! bands Poppin'Party and Roselia play a one-night joint live at Ariake Arena, with the venue listing doors at 16:30 and showtime at 18:00.

events.title: 2PM JAPAN 15th Anniversary Concert “THE RETURN” in TOKYO DOME
events.summary: 2PM mark their Japan 15th anniversary with two Tokyo Dome concerts on May 9 and 10, as listed on Tokyo Dome's official concert schedule.

events.title: Kenny Dope in Tokyo 2026
events.summary: Kenny Dope plays MIDNIGHT EAST in Shibuya, joined by Captain Vinyl, Kango, Yuna Yabe and an Azumaya-floor lineup curated by Manhattan Records.

events.title: DREAMS COME TRUE CONCERT TOUR 2026 THE BLACK ◯ ALBUM
events.summary: DREAMS COME TRUE bring their THE BLACK ◯ ALBUM tour to Ariake Arena for two Tokyo concerts, both listed with 15:30 doors and 17:00 starts.

events.title: SEVENTEEN 2026 JAPAN FANMEETING 'YAKUSOKU'
events.summary: SEVENTEEN hold two Tokyo Dome dates for their 2026 Japan fanmeeting 'YAKUSOKU', with official times listed for May 13 and May 14.

events.title: TOKYO METROPOLITAN ROCK FESTIVAL 2026
events.summary: METROCK's Tokyo edition is confirmed for May 16–17 at Umi no Mori Park, with the official page listing the festival title, dates, venue and ticket categories.

events.title: DEFTONES JAPAN 2026
events.summary: Deftones play Tokyo Garden Theater on May 18 as part of their Japan 2026 dates, with Creativeman listing a 19:00 start.

events.title: Nogizaka46 14th YEAR BIRTHDAY LIVE
events.summary: Nogizaka46's 14th YEAR BIRTHDAY LIVE takes over Tokyo Dome for three dates, with the third night billed as Minami Umezawa's graduation concert.

events.title: Reprise: Andrea Zapata / DJ Nobu
events.summary: Reprise at WOMB pairs Peruvian techno DJ Andrea Zapata with DJ Nobu on the main floor, with Akiram En and lostbaggage also listed on the lineup.

events.title: ARASHI LIVE TOUR 2026 “We are ARASHI”
events.summary: ARASHI's “We are ARASHI” tour reaches Tokyo Dome on May 31, with Tokyo Dome listing an 18:00 start for the concert.
